title: ESG-FTSE: A corpus of news articles with ESG relevance labels and use cases
reasoning: The paper develops and benchmarks a corpus for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) classification. While ESG involves corporate social responsibility and ethical investment criteria, the study is focused on a technical NLP classification task (categorizing news articles into ESG pillars) rather than evaluating religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical philosophy in language models.
